name: ERP System
short: Inventory, purchasing, sales, accounting and HR in one place.
title: ERP software that fits how your business runs
intro: One system for stock, purchasing, sales, accounting and people, so every team works from the same numbers instead of separate spreadsheets.

modules.title: Inventory & warehouses
modules.text: Stock across locations, batches and serials, transfers, reorder alerts and stock valuation.

modules.title: Purchasing
modules.text: Purchase requests, approvals, supplier quotes, POs and goods received notes.

modules.title: Sales & invoicing
modules.text: Quotations, sales orders, delivery notes, invoices and customer statements.

modules.title: Accounting
modules.text: Chart of accounts, journals, receivables, payables, VAT/tax and financial reports.

modules.title: HR & payroll
modules.text: Employees, attendance, leave and monthly payroll linked to accounting.

modules.title: Reports & dashboards
modules.text: Live sales, margin, stock and cash-flow dashboards for owners and managers.

faqs.question: Can we start with only some modules?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most clients start with inventory and sales, then switch on purchasing, accounting and HR as their team settles in.

faqs.question: Can you move our data from spreadsheets or old software?
faqs.answer: Yes. We import products, customers, suppliers, opening stock and balances as part of the setup.

faqs.question: Does it support multiple branches and currencies?
faqs.answer: Yes, with per-branch stock and users, and multi-currency invoicing.

name: School Management System
short: Admissions, attendance, fees, exams and parent portals.
title: School management software for the whole campus
intro: Run admissions, classes, attendance, fees, exams and parent communication from one system, with apps for teachers, students and parents.

modules.title: Admissions & student records
modules.text: Online applications, enrolment, documents and complete student profiles.

modules.title: Attendance
modules.text: Daily and period-wise attendance for students and staff, with automatic absence alerts to parents.

modules.title: Fees & finance
modules.text: Fee structures, discounts, invoices, online payments, receipts and defaulter reports.

modules.title: Exams & report cards
modules.text: Exam schedules, marks entry, grading rules and printable report cards.

modules.title: Timetable & classes
modules.text: Classes, sections, subjects, teacher allocation and timetables.

modules.title: Parent & student portal
modules.text: Mobile app with homework, results, fees, notices and messages.

faqs.question: Is there a mobile app for parents?
faqs.answer: Yes. Parents can see attendance, homework, results and fee status, and pay fees online from their phone.

faqs.question: Can it handle multiple campuses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each campus has its own data and staff, with consolidated reports for the head office.

faqs.question: Can we use our own school branding?
faqs.answer: Yes. The portal and apps carry your school's name, logo and colours.

name: Courier & Delivery Management
short: Bookings, dispatch, rider apps, live tracking and COD.
title: Courier and delivery management software
intro: Take bookings, assign riders, track every parcel live and settle cash-on-delivery, with apps for your riders and a tracking page for your customers.
audience: E-commerce brands running their own fleet

modules.title: Booking & order intake
modules.text: Manual, bulk CSV and API bookings, with automatic rates by zone and weight.

modules.title: Dispatch & routing
modules.text: Assign riders manually or automatically, with optimised multi-stop routes.

modules.title: Rider app
modules.text: Pickups, deliveries, proof of delivery with photo and signature, and failed-attempt reasons.

modules.title: Live tracking
modules.text: Real-time rider location for dispatchers and a branded tracking link for customers.

modules.title: COD & settlements
modules.text: Cash collection, rider cash reconciliation and merchant payouts.

modules.title: Merchant portal
modules.text: Shippers create orders, print labels and download reports themselves.

faqs.question: Do riders need a special device?
faqs.answer: No. The rider app runs on ordinary Android and iPhone devices.

faqs.question: Can our e-commerce clients send orders automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes, through store plugins or our API, so orders arrive without manual entry.

faqs.question: Does it handle cash on delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. Collected cash is tracked per rider and reconciled into merchant payouts.

name: CRM & Sales Pipeline
short: Leads, deals, follow-ups and sales reporting.
title: A CRM your sales team will actually use
intro: Capture every lead, track every deal and automate follow-ups, in a CRM shaped around your own sales process instead of a generic one.

modules.title: Lead capture
modules.text: Leads from website forms, WhatsApp, ads and email land in one inbox automatically.

modules.title: Pipeline & deals
modules.text: Visual pipelines with stages, values and expected close dates.

modules.title: Follow-up automation
modules.text: Reminders, sequences and tasks so no lead goes cold.

modules.title: Quotes & proposals
modules.text: Branded quotes generated from deal data and sent for e-signature.

modules.title: Team & targets
modules.text: Assignments, round-robin routing, targets and leaderboards.

modules.title: Sales reports
modules.text: Conversion, source and revenue reports in real time.

faqs.question: Can you import our existing contacts?
faqs.answer: Yes, from spreadsheets or other CRMs, including deal history where available.

faqs.question: Can AI help our sales team?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can add AI lead scoring, call and email summaries, and suggested next steps.

faqs.question: Will it work on mobile?
faqs.answer: Yes, the CRM is fully usable on phones for teams in the field.

name: HR & Payroll
short: Employee records, leave, attendance and payroll runs.
title: HR and payroll software without the paperwork
intro: Keep employee records, attendance, leave and payroll in one system, with a self-service app so staff stop emailing HR for every request.

modules.title: Employee records
modules.text: Profiles, contracts, documents and expiry alerts for visas and IDs.

modules.title: Attendance & shifts
modules.text: Shift planning, biometric or mobile check-in, overtime and late tracking.

modules.title: Leave management
modules.text: Leave policies, balances and approval workflows.

modules.title: Payroll
modules.text: Salary structures, allowances, deductions, loans and payslips.

modules.title: Employee self-service
modules.text: App for leave requests, payslips, documents and announcements.

modules.title: HR reports
modules.text: Headcount, cost, turnover and attendance reports.

faqs.question: Does it support local labour rules?
faqs.answer: We configure leave, overtime, end-of-service and payroll rules to match your country and policies.

faqs.question: Can employees check in from their phones?
faqs.answer: Yes, with optional location checks for field and remote staff.

faqs.question: Can payroll post to our accounts automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes, payroll journals can sync to your accounting system.

name: Inventory & POS
short: Multi-branch stock, point of sale and suppliers.
title: Inventory and POS for shops and multi-branch retail
intro: Sell in-store and online from the same stock, with fast checkout, barcode support and live inventory across every branch.

modules.title: Point of sale
modules.text: Fast checkout with barcode scanning, discounts, split payments and receipts, even offline.

modules.title: Inventory
modules.text: Real-time stock per branch, transfers, adjustments and low-stock alerts.

modules.title: Purchasing & suppliers
modules.text: Purchase orders, supplier balances and goods receiving.

modules.title: Customers & loyalty
modules.text: Customer accounts, credit sales and loyalty points.

modules.title: Online store sync
modules.text: Stock and orders synced with your e-commerce store.

modules.title: Sales reports
modules.text: Daily sales, best sellers, margins and cashier reports.

faqs.question: Does the POS work if the internet drops?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sales continue offline and sync when the connection is back.

faqs.question: Can each branch have its own stock and prices?
faqs.answer: Yes, with central control from head office.

faqs.question: Which hardware do we need?
faqs.answer: A tablet or PC, plus optional barcode scanner, receipt printer and cash drawer. We help you choose.

name: Clinic & Appointment Management
short: Bookings, patient records, billing and reminders.
title: Clinic management and online appointment booking
intro: Online booking, patient records, prescriptions and billing in one place, with automatic reminders that cut no-shows.

modules.title: Online booking
modules.text: Patients book from your website or WhatsApp based on real doctor availability.

modules.title: Reminders
modules.text: Automatic SMS and WhatsApp reminders and easy rescheduling.

modules.title: Patient records
modules.text: Visit history, notes, prescriptions, files and lab results.

modules.title: Billing & insurance
modules.text: Invoices, packages, payments and insurance claims.

modules.title: Staff schedules
modules.text: Doctor and staff rosters across rooms and branches.

modules.title: Reports
modules.text: Appointments, revenue, no-shows and doctor performance.

faqs.question: Is patient data kept private?
faqs.answer: Access is role-based, data is encrypted, and the system can be hosted in your preferred region.

faqs.question: Can patients pay online when booking?
faqs.answer: Yes, deposits or full payments can be taken at booking.

faqs.question: Does it work for non-medical businesses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Salons, spas and consultants use the same booking and reminders without the medical modules.

name: Property Management
short: Units, tenants, leases, rent collection and maintenance.
title: Property management software for landlords and agencies
intro: Track every unit, tenant and lease, collect rent on time and handle maintenance requests, with a portal for tenants and owners.

modules.title: Properties & units
modules.text: Buildings, units, amenities and occupancy at a glance.

modules.title: Tenants & leases
modules.text: Contracts, renewals, deposits and document storage with expiry alerts.

modules.title: Rent collection
modules.text: Automatic invoices, reminders, online payments and arrears tracking.

modules.title: Maintenance
modules.text: Tenants raise requests, vendors are assigned and costs tracked.

modules.title: Owner statements
modules.text: Monthly statements and payouts for property owners.

modules.title: Listings & leads
modules.text: Vacant units published with enquiries flowing into the system.

faqs.question: Can tenants pay rent online?
faqs.answer: Yes, through the tenant portal, with automatic receipts.

faqs.question: Can owners see their own properties?
faqs.answer: Yes, owners get a portal with statements, occupancy and maintenance history.

faqs.question: Does it handle short-term rentals?
faqs.answer: Core lease management is built for long-term rentals; short-term booking can be added as a custom module.

name: Learning Management System (LMS)
short: Online courses, quizzes, certificates and payments.
title: Your own online learning platform
intro: Sell and deliver courses under your own brand, with video lessons, quizzes, certificates and payments, instead of paying commission to marketplaces.

modules.title: Courses & lessons
modules.text: Video, PDF and live-session lessons organised into courses and modules.

modules.title: Quizzes & assignments
modules.text: Auto-graded quizzes, assignments and progress tracking.

modules.title: Certificates
modules.text: Branded certificates issued automatically on completion.

modules.title: Payments & subscriptions
modules.text: One-off purchases, subscriptions, coupons and bundles.

modules.title: Student app
modules.text: Learners study on web and mobile with offline-friendly video.

modules.title: Instructor & admin dashboards
modules.text: Enrolments, revenue, completion and engagement reports.

faqs.question: Can we protect videos from being downloaded?
faqs.answer: Yes, with secure streaming and watermarking options.

faqs.question: Can we run corporate training with private groups?
faqs.answer: Yes. Companies can get private groups, assigned courses and progress reports.

faqs.question: Do you charge a commission on our sales?
faqs.answer: No. You pay for setup and hosting; course revenue is yours.
